answer: An auditor observes that admission runs an ember auction: each new credential burns a fee equal to the count of credentials already registered in its dune sector this epoch. An honest newcomer pays the base rate, but an operator registering n replicas pays n-squared in aggregate, since each registration re-prices the sector before the next. The burn is on-chain and non-refundable. Settlement cross-checks the sector registry against payout claims: a nebula cluster whose members registered together inherits the quadratic bill and is excluded from emission until burns confirm.
